info.title: ShipWithAli Owner API
info.description: Authenticated, command-oriented Owner transport contract. The implemented slices cover Portfolio Configuration, content Publication, Project intent, controlled Taxonomy evolution, private Media acceptance, CV Portfolio history, Feedback Moderation, immutable Analytics goal versions, and versioned Owner exports without exposing raw tables, provider objects, or runtime code.

get.summary: Inspect an Analytics goal and its version history
get.description: Returns immutable goal definitions and the explicit active-version pointer. A caller-generated goal ID without a stored root returns not found; clients initialize a goal through the create-version operation with If-Match: 1.

post.description: For a caller-generated goal ID without a stored root, If-Match: 1 atomically initializes the root and immutable first version. Otherwise If-Match must match the current aggregate version and appends the next immutable definition. Version creation does not change the currently active version.

201.description: Immutable Analytics goal version created but not activated.

post.description: Changes the active pointer while preserving every immutable goal-version definition.
Requests a documented domain package subject to privacy and Retention policy rules.

OwnerSession.name: sw_owner_session
OwnerSession.description: A server-verified Supabase session originating from GitHub OAuth. The authenticated actor must also match the configured Owner allowlist; authentication alone never grants Owner authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Visible-ASCII client value scoped by operation and Owner. Exact replay returns the original safe result; conflicting reuse returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted expected aggregate version used for optimistic concurrency.

BadRequestProblem.description: The transport input is malformed or violates its declared shape.

UnauthenticatedProblem.description: The Owner session is missing, invalid, or expired.

ForbiddenProblem.description: The authenticated actor is not in the configured Owner allowlist.

NotFoundProblem.description: The requested aggregate does not exist.

ConflictProblem.description: The intent conflicts with identity, state, or idempotency history.

FailedPreconditionProblem.description: If-Match does not match the current aggregate version.

UnprocessableProblem.description: Valid transport input failed a publication, evidence, or domain rule.

RateLimitedProblem.description: The Owner operation exceeded its rate limit.

InternalProblem.description: An unexpected failure occurred without exposing internal detail.

TemporarilyUnavailableProblem.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.
